name: Agentic Inventory
tagline: A production-grade, polyglot microservices platform engineered for real-time stock management, statistical demand forecasting, multi-database dialect persistence, and agentic AI-driven inventory intelligence.
description:
A production-grade, polyglot microservices platform engineered for real-time stock management, statistical demand forecasting, multi-database dialect persistence, and agentic AI-driven inventory intelligence.

Microservices Architecture

☕ inventory-service

Java 17/21 • Spring Boot 3.4.1 • Port 8081
Core transactional engine managing stock items, batch adjustments, non-blocking 2-phase reservation units (reserve/claim/release), immutable audit logs, Spring Security RBAC, and Kafka mutation events. Pluggable across 5 database dialects.

🤖 forecasting-service

Python 3.11 • FastAPI • Port 8083
Scikit-Learn trained ML intent classifier (1,700+ queries across 15 intents), NER entity extraction, dual-mode Gemini/OpenAI router with offline local ML fallback, and statistical demand forecasting.

🔌 Pluggable Multi-Database Dialects

Zero vendor lock-in via custom runtime query dialect abstraction supporting PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, and IBM DB2 with programmatic transaction boundaries.

🚀 One-Command Environment Management

Step 1: Bootstrap Environment

Tears down existing volumes, sets up target database engine, compiles services, launches containers, and seeds sample data:

./scripts/setup.sh fresh postgres
Step 2: Hot-Reload Microservices

Rebuilds and reloads microservice containers on code changes without interrupting database volumes or Kafka brokers:

./scripts/setup.sh reload forecasting-service
